thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for service=inference-tail (eu-west). Metric p99 > 2s for 5m. PagerID=PD-2060. dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/PD-2060

sam_oncall: ack — grabbing dashboards and logs

sam_oncall: quick snapshot: p99 ~2.6s, p95 ~1.2s. Big spike looks to come from one customer token (cust-phi42) — traffic ~10x baseline in last 10m

mira_sre: @kevin_infra can you confirm infra saturation on eu-west dedicated capacity?

kevin_infra: checking GPUs... dedicated-gpu-pool-eu-west shows util=98%, queue depth spiking, OOM-ish evictions on sidecar. Top talker: cust-phi42, model=redwood-v1-large, batch_size median=64

kevin_infra: logs tail (10 lines):
```
2026-03-17T21:14:02Z INF request src=cust-phi42 tokens=512 batch=64 model=redwood-v1-large
2026-03-17T21:14:05Z WARN kvcache-miss model=redwood-v1-large shard=3
2026-03-17T21:14:07Z ERR oom sidecar=sidecar-12 pod=dpool-7
```

kevin_infra: quick mitigations we can do now: scale the pool (+2 gpus), route cust-phi42 to best-effort non-dedicated queue, temporarily enforce max_batch_size=16 for them, or fall back to quantized model variant.

sam_oncall: scaling pool now — running: `kubectl scale --replicas=+2 deployment/dedicated-gpu-pool-eu-west`

pd-bot: PD alert note — pager PD-2060 acknowledged by sam_oncall. Escalation timer paused.

sarah_support: CS update — cust-phi42 reported degraded responses ~10m ago, they say a new ingestion job started this morning and may be misconfigured; they've been asked to pause.

mira_sre: scaling finished, added 2 gpus. performance: p99 dropping to ~1.9s in metrics. continuing to monitor for 10m.

sam_oncall: rolling a temporary traffic rule to route cust-phi42 to best-effort pool and apply max_batch_size=16. config snippet:
```
route_rule {
  match: "customer_id=cust-phi42"
  route_to: "best_effort_pool-eu"
  overrides: { max_batch_size: 16 }
}
```

kevin_infra: route applied, cache warming. Recommend also forcing fallback to redwood-v1-large-quant for that customer while they fix ingestion.

sarah_support: cust-phi42 confirmed they paused the ingestion job. They asked for ETA — gave a tentative "30-45m" to verify normal.

mira_sre: recent 1m window: p99=1.6s, p95=1.1s. Looks stable. Will keep elevated retention on tracing for 1h.

sam_oncall: de-escalating to monitoring. PD ticket PD-2060 resolved. Handoff to @mira_sre for 2h watch and post-incident note. :white_check_mark:

mira_sre: ack handoff, will monitor and file follow-up with root cause (customer-side crawler + missing rate-limits). Planning a short runbook tweak to surface excessive per-customer QPS earlier.

sam_oncall: adding note to incident log: "Mitigation: scaled pool + traffic route + batch limit + customer paused ingestion". Closing thread.
